QuestInfo.name: Grandis: Unknown Energy
QuestInfo.0:
A mysterious power sweeps over Continental Grandis, and unique phenomena appear there.
- Only up to two heroes can hunt in the field.
- Monsters will not appear for any other heroes in the field beyond the first two.
- If you enter while already in a party, the party will be disbanded.
- Elite Monsters, Elite Champions, and Elite Bosses will not appear.
- Runes of Darkness will not appear either, nor will Runes of Riches.
